title: Maria Wang says her husband reported directly to Henry Kissinger

tellings.quote: She said that her husband had reported directly to Henry Kissinger.

plain: A woman named Maria Wang said that her husband, who worked in the 1950s at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, reported directly to Henry Kissinger, the man who later became US Secretary of State. Michels passes this on from what she said, in an episode asking whether Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs, which is what it would hint at if true.
